title: 新墨西哥大學沉浸式學習計畫分享會--開啟你的美國學習之旅 University of New Mexico Summer English Immersion Program Sharing Session
department: 國際事務處國際學生組

author.department: 國際事務處國際學生組

content:
分類： 活動公告
來源： 國際事務處國際學生組 - 陳良愛 - issa@gms.ndhu.edu.tw - 電話5107
對象： 全校學生
標題： 新墨西哥大學沉浸式學習計畫分享會--開啟你的美國學習之旅 University of New Mexico Summer English Immersion Program Sharing Session
日期： Wed, 2 Apr 2025 11:33:53 +0800
附檔： NDHU July session flyer (1).png (2 MB)   NDHU Prelim Calendar Summer 2025 (1).pdf (66 KB)   
想要提升你的英語能力並體驗美國文化嗎？新墨西哥大學提供暑期沉浸式英語學習課程，讓學生能夠在學術環境中強化英語能力，同時參與豐富的文化活動。

國際處特別邀請 Mr. Paul Edmunds向大家介紹關於暑期沉浸式英語學習課程內容、申請方式以及學習環境。無論您對語言學習有興趣，或是計畫前往美國進修，這場分享會將提供您寶貴的資訊與建議，歡迎踴躍參加！

日期：04月16日
時間：12:10 PM - 13:00 PM
地點：行政大樓 301室
活動報名時間：即日起至04/14 中午12點
報名連結：https://sys.ndhu.edu.tw/SA/XSL_ApplyRWD/ActAnnounce.aspx?ActID=25070


Do you want to improve your English skills and experience American culture? University of New Mexico (UNM) offers a Summer English Immersion Program, allowing students to enhance their English proficiency in an academic setting while participating in diverse cultural activities.

Join us for an exciting info session with Mr. Paul Edmunds from University of New Mexico(UNM) as he introduces Summer English Immersion Program. Learn about program detail, application process and study environment. If you're considering studying in America, this session is the perfect opportunity to gain insights and prepare for your journey!

About UNM:
The University of New Mexico (UNM) is a flagship public research university in Albuquerque, founded in 1889, and the largest in the state with 22,630 students in 2023. Classified as an R1 research institution and a Hispanic-Serving Institution, UNM spent over $243 million on research in 2021.

Date: April 16th
Time: 12:10 PM - 13:00 PM
Location: Administration Building, Room 301
Registration for the event is open from now until 12:00 PM on April 14th.
